recommendation_contract: Choose one best next action, explain why, and ask before it runs.
required_connector_behavior: If any required-all connector is absent, or no required-any option is active, keep the best action visible but mark it blocked and name what must be connected.
optional_connector_behavior: A missing optional connector does not block the action, but the omitted input must be disclosed before confirmation.
zero_connector_behavior: When no tools are connected, use smb-onboard as the immediate next step; for a specific request, also identify the connector its eventual action needs.
tiebreakers: Urgent cash concerns take priority over marketing concerns.
An active customer complaint takes priority over a pipeline review.
If urgency is equal and the direction remains unclear, present no more than two choices and ask one clarifying question.
outside_scope_behavior: Say the request is outside the catalog; do not invent an action, and briefly redirect to the four supported buckets.
